name: The Hartsblight
summary: A fungal rot pours out of a forest north-west of Wickermoor, and a satyr who answers to Gorthos is its heart.

stages.journal: A rot called the Hartsblight is coming out of the forest beyond Moonsong Lake. Sister Rain, or the Mayor's panic, sent us after it.
stages.hint: Follow the spore trail north-west to the Patient Lady commune.

stages.journal: The commune is dead, eighteen bodies rotted too fast, and a ring of druids drums at the tree line.
objectives: Stop the Circle of the Hartsblight
stages.hint: Deal with the druids at the tree line, or slip past them into the forest.

stages.journal: The Circle's drums have gone quiet, or we left them to their work. The forest waits.
stages.hint: Enter the forest by the altar of rot.

stages.journal: We have walked into the Blighted Wood. The rot gets into us a little with every league.
objectives: Visit all three places of the outer stand
stages.hint: Visit the pine barrens, the outcrop and the hollow before going deeper.

stages.journal: The middle wood is thick with spore clouds and a commune of druids in the trees.
stages.hint: Pass the druids' commune and see the ravine, the quagmire and the grove.

stages.journal: The Rotten Heart: a sallow river, a ring of standing stones, and a pool with a dead woman in it.
objectives: Destroy what is left of Gwenna
stages.hint: Cross the river and reach the wellspring.

stages.journal: A slime trail leads to a cave under a ridge, and a voice that has been talking to us all the way.
stages.hint: Follow the slime trail north to the den.

stages.journal: Gorthos died a second time with Gwenna's name in her mouth, and the rot went out of us.
stages.hint: Return to Sister Rain in Wickermoor.

stages.journal: We told Sister Rain what we found. The Patient Lady's missionaries will go to the forest's edge.
